title: Can a Solo Traveller Book a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes, but the price is per boat, so one person pays the same 400 to 600 EUR as five. Here is when it is worth it alone, and which cheaper shared trips exist.
heroAlt: Solo traveller seen from behind sitting alone near the front of a boat off Ribeira Brava
keywords: can a solo traveller book a private boat trip in madeira
private boat trip for one person funchal
solo traveller things to do madeira

images.prompt: Mid-afternoon off Ribeira Brava on Madeira's south coast, seen from the back of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking forward. One person, seen from behind, sits alone near the front with knees drawn up, looking at the coast. The other grey seats are empty. Ahead, the village of Ribeira Brava in its valley mouth with green slopes rising behind. Calm deep blue sea, bright natural light, true colours.
images.alt: Solo traveller seen from behind sitting alone near the front of a boat off Ribeira Brava
